tagline: A fast online arena shooter: air-strafe and launch-pad around Shattercore, a rift arena with a glowing monolith at its heart.
overview:
RiftRaze is a hyperkinetic online arena first-person shooter built on RedEngine. Its arena, Shattercore, is one connected volume: a central rift monolith, three upper galleries reached by two stair approaches, lower routes, and two cyan launch pads that fling you up and across.

Movement is the point: a wide 95-degree view, 9 m/s base speed, air strafing and momentum you keep (up to 20 m/s). One player hosts and others join; once two players are ready a seven-minute free-for-all begins, first to 40 kills wins. Everyone spawns with a shotgun and can cycle through the engine's full arsenal. Like RedDM, the arena is still a greybox.
story: No story: RiftRaze is a pure arena shooter. Shattercore is a broken place built around a rift that hums in the middle of the floor, and the only thing to do there is move fast and shoot first.
goal: Be the first to 40 kills in a seven-minute round (free for all).
rules: A round needs at least two ready players.
Every kill scores one; first to 40, or the most kills at seven minutes, wins.
Cyan launch pads throw you high across the arena; the galleries are reached by stairs or pads.
You keep your speed in the air: strafe to steer and build momentum.
Everyone starts with a shotgun; the mouse wheel cycles the other weapons.
